# Fresh Start Resume

> A free, private resume builder in English and Spanish. You answer 7 short steps, see a one-page resume build as you type, then print it or save it as a PDF. Made for people leaving homelessness and anyone who needs a resume and has no easy way to make one. It saves nothing and tracks nothing.

## What it is
- A single web page that runs in your browser. No account, no sign-up, no cost.
- Two resume styles (Simple and Modern). The page and the resume can each be in English or Spanish.
- Works on a phone or a library computer, and offline once the page has loaded.

## Privacy
- Your information never leaves your device. No cookies, no localStorage, no analytics, no third-party requests.
- Everything lives in page memory and is gone when you close the page, so print or save as PDF first.
- The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may keep standard visit logs that this project cannot see or control.

## Links
- [Fresh Start Resume](https://brianallengit.github.io/fresh-start-resume/): the tool.
- [Source code and license (MIT)](https://github.com/BrianAllenGit/fresh-start-resume): open source.

## Limits
- It does not give career or legal advice and does not submit resumes anywhere.
- The Spanish text has not yet been reviewed by a native speaker.
